notes.title: Upcoming Game Update 0.8.0
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!

Wanted to share we’re actively working on our next update. [/p][p align="start"]Here’s a short breakdown of what’s [i]in the works[/i] and what you might expect to see.[/p][p align="start"][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h3]🔁 New Play Types[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We’re continuing to expand your tactical toolbox:[/p][p align="start"][/p][list][*][p][b]QB Draw[/b] – Let your mobile quarterbacks shine with designed runs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Run Option Plays[/b] – Adds more offensive flexibility and decision-making.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Situational Play Calls[/b] – You’ll feel better equipped for specific in-game scenarios (e.g., short yardage, red zone, etc.).[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h3]🧠 2D Engine Improvements + AI Logic[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We’re tuning the core systems to make every down feel smarter and smoother:[/p][p align="start"][/p][list][*][p]Smarter [b]defensive recognition[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved  [b]play variety[/b] from AI teams[/p][/*][*][p]Various fixes to [b]animations and player positioning[/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h3]🏆 New Game Mode: "Legends"  - Leaderboard Challenge[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We’re introducing a new [b]competitive franchise mode[/b], where you start with a struggling franchise and get 25 seasons to turn things around:
[/p][list][*][p]All GM's will have same set of rules, cap and game difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Once you complete the 25 seasons, your performance will be graded based on various factors and you land on an [b]all-time leaderboard[/b]. and see where you compare with the rest of the community![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h3]💬 Community Requests & Quality-of-Life Fixes[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We’re listening closely, and a bunch of your suggestions are being included, like [b]s[/b]ome additional fixes to award[b] [/b]and HOF projections, and various UI and gameplay tweaks based on your feedback.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Your support means a lot — and your suggestions continue to shape the direction of the game.[/p][p align="start"]Let us know what you’re most excited about, or what you’d love to see next![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: 0.6.8 Release notes
notes.content:
Hey coaches!
Made another small batch of fixes and adjustments to improve gameplay.

	•	Adjusted dropped-pass ratio
	•	Improved route cut angles on 2D engine
	•	Additional fine-tuning to difficulty settings
	•	Bug Fixes

notes.title: 0.6.7 Release Notes
notes.content:
Hey Coaches!
We have made a small game update with much needed adjustments and tweaks:

- Improved contested catch logic
- Improved ball carrier evade/skill move
- Fixed draft projection accuracy
- Fine tuned difficultly settings

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: 🏈 Our Game Is Live! 🎉
notes.content:
[p]Hey Coaches![/p][p]We’re incredibly excited to announce that [b]Ultimate Pro Football Coach[/b] is now officially [b]LIVE[/b] on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a long road getting here — from mobile roots to this full PC & Mac premium experience — and we’ve packed it with everything we have every wanted in one game:[/p][p]✅ 2D top-down game engine[/p][p]✅ Real-time play calling[/p][p]✅ Deep draft & scouting systems[/p][p]✅ Custom playbooks and play creator[/p][p]✅ Ring of Honor, Hall of Fame, full stat tracking[/p][p]…and much much more.[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, the game is [b]25% off[/b] for launch discount![/p][p][/p][p]🎮 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3795200"]Click here to play now[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for all the posts, and support that helped along the way.

If you end up trying it out, we’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback - this can really help shape this game into something really special.
[/p][p]See you on the sidelines. [/p]

notes.title: Final Testing Phase!
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to share that [b]Ultimate Pro Football Coach[/b] is now entering its final testing phase![/p][p][/p][p]Over the past few months, we’ve been building a game inspired by everything the football sim community has been asking for — a full-featured, deep, single-player franchise experience with real strategic control.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]💡 Built for the Fans[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This game was shaped directly by your feedback.[/p][p]We saw what players were asking for over the years and made it our mission to deliver:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]⚙️ Real team-building and cap management[/p][/*][*][p]🧠 Deep playbooks and editable plays[/p][/*][*][p]📈 Realistic scouting, injuries, progression and player traits[/p][/*][*][p]🏆 Hall of Fame, team history, legacy tracking[/p][/*][*][p]🧢 Coach and staff systems with career progression[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 Smooth 2D top-down gameplay tied to attributes and strategy[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]📅 Launch Is Coming Soon[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re on track to release on time. Until then, we’ll continue polishing features, fixing bugs, and getting ready to welcome you into your new locker room.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🛒 Wishlist Now![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Wishlisting helps us a ton — and you’ll be first to know when we launch.[/p]
